method: Complete pinned tutorial read and Git/SHA256 verification. All commands treated as examples, no scan/removal/install executed. Cross-referenced previously read implementations.
findings: Tutorial explicitly defines duplicate match as either exact equality or matching hashes depending on settings; ordinary hash results are not byte-equality certificates. Cryptographic probability prose is not independently validated here.
Original means retained representative, not historical source. Tagged paths outrank rank-by; keep-all-tagged is distinct from preference, and must-match-tagged intentionally limits output.

Size/name/extension/mtime/hidden/depth/mount filters intentionally change eligible domain. Empty files require explicit duplicate configuration in examples; lint categories differ from exact-equality groups.
Clamp compares chosen byte interval and ignores too-short files; identical ranges do not establish whole-file equality. Our forced-digest/full-byte controls remain separate evidence.

Directory merging is explicitly experimental, retains records until end and warns about concurrent filesystem changes. Merkle-tree prose does not override previously reproduced count/XOR/distinct-set multiplicity weakness.

Replay reuses stored results and hashing/algorithm/paranoid/traversal options have no effect. Newer-mtime filtering is not reliable changed-content detection when mtime is preserved. No fresh content proof from replay.
Stamp is run timestamp, not completed-success checkpoint; earlier formatter source writes at INIT. Incremental example cannot establish recovery after interrupted traversal.

xattr modes write metadata and may hash duplicates only, same-size unmatched or uniques depending options. This qualifies introductory never modifies filesystem assertion and changes workload of first/warm runs.
NUL-delimited find example addresses newline filenames; later hidden-exclusion pipeline places -print0 on grep rather than find, so it is not a valid general NUL-path recipe. No examples executed.

Shell formatter remove/symlink never fails prose is too broad for IO/permissions/resource errors and not a checked invariant. JSON header/footer can be configured off, so fixed slicing recipes depend on defaults.
Tutorial unit conventions distinguish decimal K/M from binary KB/MB, whereas GUI widget uses1024 with named units. Cross-UI equality of entered sizes needs explicit translation.
Referenced screenshot was already visually reviewed; SVG link target and remaining media receive no duplicate or new review credit.
limits: Documentation/source cross-check only; no new runtime or throughput evidence.
